text:
mike: noticing a sudden bump in 503s for /v1/embeddings in eu-west1 since 08:42. Error surface on dedicated nodes running embed:v2.2.5. I built a hotfix image embed:v2.2.6-pin that fixes the kv eviction race. Requesting expedited deploy to Dedicated eu pool, prefer canary-skip due to impact.
rohan: can we at least do a micro-canary (1 node, 3m)? skipping entirely worries me.
sasha: tests: unit+smoke+staging-integration all green on v2.2.6-pin. Patch built from main @ commit 7f4d. Artifact: gs://redwood-builds/embeddings/7f4d.tar.gz.
mike: @deploybot please run preflight and list blockers.
deploybot: Preflight -> smoke: PASS; infra-check: PASS; migrations: NONE; open-release-PRs: 0; canary-tests: RECOMMENDED. Interactive approvals required: ops + product. React with :thumbsup: within 10m to approve micro-canary or canary-skip.
anna: oncall (anna) here. I'm +1 for micro-canary only. Need rollback command and kill-switch documented in thread.
sasha: rollback commands tested in staging:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-service embed=redwood/embed:v2.2.5
./scripts/flush-embed-kv --cluster eu-west1 --confirm
```
If canary error_rate > 1% or p95 > 2x baseline abort and run above.
anna: :thumbsup: (ops)
jen: product here, impact > SLO, micro-canary ok. posting signoff for audit.
mike: approved. launching deploy id deploy_1747777777_micro. Canary: 1 node for 3m, then staged roll (concurrency=1).
deploybot: Deploy triggered by mike. Canary started (node-03). Canary health: PASS after 3m. Proceeding to staged roll. Rolling nodes: 2/6 updated; 4/6 updated; 6/6 updated. Post-deploy smoke: PASS. Traffic shift to v2.2.6-pin complete.
mike: Monitoring window 10m. Watch embeds-errors and p95-latency. If regressions, run rollback above and ping #incidents.
sasha: +6m: metrics stable, error-rate back to baseline. No customer reports.
mike: updating changelog: "hotfix(embed): pin runtime to v2.2.6 to fix KV eviction race causing 503s" and notifying support to tag possibly affected tickets. Thanks all for quick review and approvals :rocket:
